claims.claim: Empty plastic water drum for water
claims.evidence: Witness only reports a blue plastic chemical drum with markings; photos do not confirm it was used for water or that it is suitable/clean for water use.

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents/chemical residue (safety and smell; may not be suitable for drinking/food use)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the drum’s full side label/markings (including any product/chemical name, hazard symbols, or cleaning statement) plus a close-up of the bung area showing any residue.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used plastic drum with unknown residue; treated as not guaranteed for potable/food use.

risks.risk: Capacity/volume uncertainty affects value and buyer utility
risks.proof: A photo showing the full capacity/volume marking (e.g., liters) on the drum side, fully readable.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst-case assumption (smaller/unknown capacity) until capacity is confirmed.

risks.risk: Lid/bung sealing condition and thread integrity (risk of leaks during transport/storage)
risks.proof: Close-up video or photos of the red bung/cap threads and the lid seal area, plus a quick water-fill or leak-test clip (even a small pour test around the bung).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing reseal/with leak risk; no guarantee of watertight performance.

risks.risk: Structural damage not visible in the provided angles (cracks, dents, warping)
risks.proof: 360-degree walkaround photos showing the entire drum body (top, bottom, and all sides) with good lighting, plus a close-up of any dents/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as intact only to the extent visible; any hidden damage treated as possible.

risks.proof: Photo of any grade/certification markings (e.g., food-grade/HDPE type, UN rating if present) and the full label text.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (bungs, taps/spigots, liners) or incomplete set
risks.proof: Photos showing what’s included: bung/cap type, any spigot/tap presence, and whether there are liners or replacement seals.

proof_requests: Send a clear, fully readable photo of the drum’s side markings/label (including capacity and any prior product/chemical info).
Send close-ups of the red bung/cap threads and the lid seal area.
Provide a short leak-test clip (e.g., pour water around the bung and show no seepage).
Send 360-degree photos including the bottom and any dents/cracks.
Confirm whether it is food-grade/for potable water use, and show any grade/certification markings.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a blue plastic drum and reports it appears intact with no visible leaks, so a worst-case price can be set. However, prior contents, capacity, and sealing/grade are not verifiable from the photos, so it should be priced conservatively until the requested proof is provided.
